briefdescription.para: Lightweight arrays that are backed by an arbitrary BinaryStream.

detaileddescription.para:
This file provides two different array implementations. VarStreamArray - Arrays of variable length records. The user specifies an Extractor type that can extract a record from a given offset and return the number of bytes consumed by the record.
FixedStreamArray - Arrays of fixed length records. This is similar in spirit to ArrayRef<T>, but since it is backed by a BinaryStream, the elements of the array need not be laid out in contiguous memory.
